models: old matched mixed-L proxy LR/XGB/State and ET; no retraining or dynamic thresholds
controls: unchanged graph, queries, weights, K10, beam4, threads4, cache10000, warm128; inherited Reader/Linux IO equality and no swap

primary.budget_per_family: 64 original configurations +96 new coarse +32 new validation-local =192 unique configs; same count for every family
primary.joint: L, gate tau and ET tau all varied
primary.local: 32 perturbations around validation winners of 6 targets x3 independent objectives
primary.selection: validation only; freeze all objective/target selections before new test grid; previously observed benchmark test queries, not a fresh unseen dataset

strict.label: descriptive test-quality calibration; NOT held-out selection
strict.target_choice: native actual hit count nearest nominal target from primary grid; each within0.15pp or reported unavailable; reference need not L100
strict.budget: up to72 additional probes per non-native family per target: six branches x(2 endpoints+10 bisection steps), no stop at first exact hit; integer duplicate heuristic probes reused
strict.branches: six L factors 1.0,1.2,1.5,2,3,4; heuristic six completed-expansion settings; joint three gate-threshold sweeps at different ET and three ET sweeps at different gate thresholds
strict.exact: equal integer GT total_hits out of10000; no interpolation, no query-dependent policy mixtures, no result truncation
strict.active: Gate/Heuristic skips>0; ET stopped_fraction>0; Joint BOTH; inactive exacts counted separately
strict.objective: select P95/QPS/bytes independently among exact active candidates; no exact =>explicit unmatched nearest record

frontiers: three independent empirical measured frontiers; every final displayed point at least3 repeats; validation-selected and exact-objective winners9 repeats
timing: datasets serial; configs randomized in blocks16; repetitions cyclic ordered; all results from one true config, with full metrics
